details.jobDescription:
At ENGIE, we believe that clean, reliable energy starts with strong foundations — and that includes the data and partnerships that power our operations. As a Supplier Data Steward, you play a key role in keeping our procurement ecosystem accurate, compliant, and efficient across France and Belgium.You work at the heart of our Global Business Services Procurement team, ensuring that supplier information is correct, complete, and actionable. Your work directly supports buyers, category managers, and suppliers every day.
What You'll Do
  • Receive, review, and approve supplier creation requests by performing data consistency and completeness checks
  • Activate and update supplier data across referential and transactional systems, including SAP and ARIBA
  • Implement supplier classification, declassification, and disqualification in the systems based on buyer decisions
  • Support buyers and category managers in launching and managing the supplier qualification process
  • Validate supplier registration and qualification, including administrative certificates and scope updates
  • Provide technical support to suppliers and internal stakeholders on SAP Business Network and all ARIBA modules
  • Guide suppliers and internal teams through onboarding on ARIBA, IMS, Ecovadis, and e-Attestation platforms
What You Bring
  • Experience in procurement operations or supplier data management is a strong asset
  • Fluency in Italian and English is essential; Romanian is required-
  • A university or college degree in a relevant field
  • Solid understanding of procurement tools, especially SAP and ARIBA platforms
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to data quality
  • Clear and confident communication skills with both internal teams and external suppliers
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment
Location︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉
Bucharest, Romania — Hybrid working arrangement. This role supports procurement operations primarily for France and Belgium, within the GBS Procurement perimeter.
What We Offer
  • A diverse and stimulating role at the crossroads of procurement, data management, and digital tools
  • A friendly and collaborative team environment within a global organisation
  • Hybrid flexibility that supports a healthy work-life balance
  • Real opportunities to grow your career within ENGIE's Global Business Services
  • Exposure to international procurement processes and cross-functional stakeholders across Europe
  • A structured onboarding and ongoing support to help you succeed from day one
Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf.
Our Commitment
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!ENGIE is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, or sexual orientation. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

Despre ENGIE Romania

Grupul ENGIE este o referință globală în domeniul energiei și al serviciilor cu emisii reduse de carbon. Alături de cei 4.250 de angajați din România, de clienți, parteneri și părți interesate, ne angajăm să accelerăm tranziția către o economie cu impact neutru în ceea ce privește emisiile de carbon, printr-un consum redus de energie și soluții prietenoase cu mediul. Inspirați de ambiția noastră, îmbinăm performanța economică cu producerea unui impact pozitiv asupra oamenilor și planetei, bazându-ne pe activitățile noastre cheie – gaze naturale, energie electrică, servicii tehnice – pentru a oferi soluții competitive clienților noștri.
